end.summary: Practised checking an answer by estimating first.
end.parentNote: Kabir practised rounding numbers and using an estimate to check whether an exact answer is reasonable. They correctly estimated 4,982 + 3,015 as about 8,000 and understood that an estimate can differ from the exact answer while staying close. They mixed up whether a different estimate is “wrong”; this was clarified later by discussing “around” answers. At home, ask them to estimate one everyday addition before calculating exactly, then compare the two answers.
